content: I am writing my own dependent type language compiler and trying to learn something from Lean4 compiler. I see toMono in Lean.Compiler.LCNF.ToMono.lean which erase all type arguments, and specialize in ....LCNF.Specialize.lean which seems only specialize over typeclass arguments instead of type arguments. My question is which pass Lean4 performs monomorphization, or if Lean4 has monomorphization?
